name: create_incident_ticket
description: create_incident_ticket: Create a new incident ticket. Returns the ticket number in INC format. The category is determined by the agent based on what the caller described — the caller does not choose the category directly.

employee_id.description: The employee affected by the incident (e.g. EMP048271).

category.description: The incident category, determined from the caller's description of the problem.

urgency.description: Urgency level inferred from the caller's business impact. low = workaround available, not time-sensitive; medium = degraded but functional; high = completely blocked, no workaround.

affected_system.description: The system or resource affected. For login or outage issues, use the system identifier (e.g. active_directory, sso_identity, email_exchange, vpn_gateway, erp_oracle, crm_platform, hr_portal, code_repository, ci_cd_pipeline, file_storage, print_service). For hardware issues, use the asset tag (e.g. AST-LPT-284719). For network issues, use vpn, wifi, or ethernet.

troubleshooting_completed.description: Whether troubleshooting steps were attempted before creating the ticket. Must be true for login and network connectivity issues.
